mentions.name: Deptheos
mentions.description: This is a free, fast focus stacking program for photography and macro photography. It supports RAW files as inputs and DNG files as outputs, using either LibRaw or Adobe DNG Converter as selectable runtime options. It is built with Swift and Metal for macOS and ships as a notarized macOS DMG; when built from source it also runs on M4/M5-series iPad Pro.
mentions.problem: Existing focus stacking programs are not fast or free; the goal is a super fast, free focus stacking tool.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building Deptheos (https://github.com/ryanmitts/deptheos), a photography/macro focus stacking program.
